job.title: 2027 DMFI Quant Developer Intern
job.description:
The Role
We are seeking an exceptional intern to join our Discretionary Macro Fixed Income (DMFI) Quant team in London where you will have an opportunity to meaningfully contribute to building and enhancing our derivatives pricing and risk infrastructure, delivering solutions that directly impact our trading operations across multiple asset classes.
What You’ll Do
Reporting to our Quant Services and Applications Lead, you will help expand the services infrastructure supporting the DMFI-QR analytics platform. The current focus of this expansion is on reference data management, market data client feed integrations, and bond curve configuration, all of which support our curve fitting services. This is a hands-on opportunity to learn how backend services are designed, built, and scaled to support real-world fixed income analytics workloads using C++ and Python. You will:
Learn how reference data and market data feeds flow into the curve fitting pipeline
Assist in building and testing integrations with market data client feeds using C++ and Python
Help design and implement configuration frameworks for bond curve construction
Support the extension of existing services to onboard new reference data sources
Collaborate with quant developers and engineers on code reviews, documentation, and testing practices
Help troubleshoot data quality, latency, or reliability issues across the feed integration layer
What You’ll Gain
Practical experience with production-grade services infrastructure in a fixed income analytics context
Hands-on experience working with C++ and Python in a real quantitative/financial engineering setting
Exposure to how bond curves are configured and consumed by curve fitting services
Hands-on understanding of market data and reference data conventions (e.g., instrument identifiers, curve tenors, data vendor formats)
Mentorship from experienced engineers and quant developers on the analytics platform team
A deeper understanding of how analytics platforms are architected and maintained at scale in financial services
What You’ll Bring
What you need:
Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Working knowledge of C++ and/or Python (coursework or project experience is fine)
Basic understanding of APIs, databases, or distributed systems (coursework or projects count!)
Interest in fixed income markets, financial data, or quantitative finance is highly encouraged
Curiosity, willingness to learn, and comfort asking questions
The ability to communicate software design and development ideas clearly and succinctly
Creative problem-solving skills and experience working with real-world datasets
Strong attention to detail
We’d love if you had:
Previous financial industry experience although it is not required
Our Internship
Kick-start your career in finance with the Schonfeld Summer Internship! Over the course of 10 action-packed weeks, you will have the opportunity to build solutions that tackle real-world challenges and leave a lasting impact on the firm. As an intern, you’ll join a close-knit team that is ready to support your growth and accelerate your career. We will pair you with a dedicated manager and a mentor who’ll guide your development over the course of the internship and beyond. Throughout the program, you will have the chance to connect with senior leaders through a series of learning sessions, attend hands-on skills workshops, network at social events and get a behind-the-scenes look at how various functions power the firm. We’ll empower you to bring your ideas to life and make an impact.
Who We Are
Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income.
Our Culture
At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.

job.title: Quant Trading Internship - Summer 2027
job.description:
Chicago Trading Company (CTC) is a premier proprietary trading firm specializing in options market making. Our collaborative culture fuels innovation in quantitative research, systematic trading strategies, and cutting-edge trading technology. For over three decades CTC has provided critical liquidity across derivatives exchanges worldwide - making them fairer, more transparent, and more efficient.
We strive to be the most innovative firm in the industry today, tomorrow, and long into the future while upholding ethical excellence. We believe that CTC makes a positive impact on the markets, the lives of our employees, and all the communities to which we belong. Started in 1995 by a team of forward-thinking Traders, we are proud to call ourselves an industry leader that keeps making markets and each other better.
The Role
As a Quant Trading (QT) Intern, you will be challenged to learn and adapt in an exciting team environment and will play a substantial role in our day-to-day trading and quant-related activities. Your impact is immediate and meaningful. You will become a member of a team for the summer and play a vital role completing project work and/or identifying trading opportunities and communicating with software engineers, quants, traders, and risk managers throughout the trading day. As part of the Summer Associate cohort, you will learn and socialize alongside other QT Interns and Software Engineering (SE) Interns.
What to Expect
The 8-week internship program gives you insight into our culture and an inward look into what our business is all about. You will participate in three classroom learning experiences including: a week-long Basics of Options class, a multi-week class on the fundamentals of market making (Mock Trading), and a multi-week class that introduces elements of our quant framework (Quant Curriculum). You will also attend planned social activities and talks from various business leaders to propel your professional growth, and build your network with CTC employees and fellow interns. You will:
Work in an impactful role mirroring that of a full-time Quant Trading Associate (QTA)
Get hands-on experience with trading and exposure to our trading technology
Have weekly one-on-one meetings with your manager to ensure you are progressing and learning throughout the program
Receive mentorship from members of our trading and/or quant teams
Experience a culture with a strong emphasis on teamwork and collaboration built through various educational and social activities
What it takes for you to be successful
You have a competitive drive and are a highly motivated individual that only gets stronger as part of a collaborative team
You have a desire to work in tandem with traders, quants, developers, and other experts to further CTC’s goal of providing world class liquidity to financial markets
You love solving complex problems
You’re intellectually curious and like to challenge the status quo
You can effectively communicate sophisticated ideas both written and verbally
Strong quantitative and analytical abilities
Basic programming skills or a willingness to learn Python
No prior experience in finance is necessary, but a deep curiosity and hunger to learn about finance and trading is essential
Key Requirements
You are pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. All majors and concentrations welcome.
You will graduate between December 2027-June 2028
You have a demonstrated record of success (academics, awards, etc.)
You are willing to relocate to Chicago, IL for the summer (with full-time placement in Chicago)
You can participate in the full duration of the 8-week program from mid-June to early August 2027
Why should you consider interning at CTC?
Be part of a fast-growing, industry-leading global trading company
Work in an environment that actively explores and applies emerging technologies — including AI — to enhance trading, engineering, and research workflows
Opportunity to work with and learn from leaders in our industry
Excellent support system to ensure your learning and development
Competitive pay, free housing with your fellow interns in downtown Chicago, and free breakfast, lunch, and snacks!
Compensation
Monthly salary of $16,500 plus a signing bonus
Please note: You are allowed to submit one application per position (i.e. SE Intern and QT Intern) during the recruiting cycle. We recommend focusing on applying for the role that aligns most closely with your skills and interests. While you can apply for more than one role, please keep in mind that each application will be assessed according to the specific requirements set for that role.
Most teams at CTC, with the exception of Trading, follow a hybrid workplace model, subject to change based on business need.
Our Benefits
We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families so we offer outstanding benefits to support you both professionally and personally. job.description:
ABOUT REVEL
At Revel, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s most critical hardware is controlled—across aerospace, automotive, energy, and manufacturing sectors. Our next-generation software stack combines an intuitive command/control interface, a specialized programming language tailored for hardware control, and a high-performance runtime environment. We empower engineers to build, test, and deploy critical systems rapidly, reliably, and safely.
THE INTERNSHIP
As a Full Stack Software Engineering Intern at Revel, you’ll help build the software interfaces and services that engineers use to interact with complex, mission-critical hardware.
You’ll work closely with experienced software engineers and operators to build intuitive browser-based interfaces, contribute to backend services and APIs, and help develop new software from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to work across the stack and see how data moves from physical hardware through backend systems and into the applications engineers use every day.
This is a great opportunity for a student who enjoys building things, cares about creating great user experiences, and wants to deepen their understanding of how modern software systems work end-to-end.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Build and improve browser-based user interfaces using modern web technologies
- Develop features in React and TypeScript/JavaScript
- Contribute to backend services and APIs that support frontend applications
- Work across the stack to build reliable data flows between hardware, backend systems, and user interfaces
- Collaborate with engineers and operators to understand real-world problems and turn them into intuitive software solutions
- Contribute to greenfield projects and help build new products from the ground up
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
- Debug issues across the frontend, backend, and underlying data systems
- Participate in code reviews and collaborate with experienced software engineers
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
- Rising Junior or Senior graduating in 2027 or 2028
- Experience building software through coursework, personal projects, research, or previous internships
- Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and familiarity with React
- Basic understanding of backend development, APIs, databases, or web services
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
- Interest in learning how software systems work end-to-end
- Strong attention to usability and user experience
- Curious, self-directed, and excited to learn from experienced engineers
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- US citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee (ITAR requirement)
BONUS POINTS
- Experience building a full-stack project from frontend through backend
- Familiarity with modern web architecture and application data flow
- Experience with frameworks or tools such as Next.js, Node.js, or similar technologies
- Experience working with databases and SQL
- Exposure to real-time, streaming, or event-driven data systems
- Experience building applications that visualize or interact with live data
- Interest in systems programming, infrastructure, performance, or developer tools
- Experience with Python, Rust, C++, or other programming languages
- Experience working on projects involving hardware, robotics, aerospace, automotive, or industrial systems
WHY REVEL
- Build software that controls real hardware — create the interfaces engineers use to interact with complex physical systems
- Work across the stack — gain experience building everything from frontend applications to backend services and data systems
- Build from the ground up — contribute to greenfield projects rather than maintaining legacy software
- Learn from exceptional engineers — work closely with experienced software engineers across the stack
- Solve real-world problems — build software used by customers across aerospace, automotive, energy, and advanced manufacturing
- Grow quickly — work in a small, ambitious team where your contributions are visible and your learning curve is steep
INTERNSHIP DETAILS
- Program: Summer 2027 Internship
- Duration: June - August 2027
- Type: Summer, paid internship
- Location: Los Angeles or San Francisco
- Work environment: On-site

Join us to redefine what’s possible in software for hardware.

About Us:
Founded more than 15 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America and in Europe. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.
DV Commodities is a division within DV Group that specializes in trading commodities markets, including crude oil, refined products, natural gas, power, emissions, metals, softs, and agriculture. DV Commodities' risk management, world-class technology, and talented traders have enabled it to become one of the world’s largest liquidity providers and risk allocators in the energy and commodities spaces. DV Commodities currently has over 35 desks, with traders and staff located in London, New York, Chicago, Houston, and Dubai.
Overview:
As a Software Development Intern, you'll work in small groups within our development team and/or trading teams to assist in building low latency applications, systems and trading tools that will make a direct impact to DV. You'll deliver well-scoped, self-contained projects within our established production codebase, learning to build new functionality that integrates cleanly with mature systems. You'll use AI tools to accelerate your development while taking full ownership of the code you ship. Through your work and other development opportunities, you will grow your technical skills and understand how our technology stack empowers our firm to serve our trading teams.
Requirements:
Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field and expected to graduate between Winter 2027 and Summer 2028
Proficient in one or more general purpose programming languages, including C++ and/or Python
Ability to read and navigate an existing codebase and deliver a contained project within it
Effective use of AI coding tools paired with the ability to critically review generated code and own its correctness
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills, ideally applied to numerical or performance-sensitive problems
Ability to work onsite at our London office 5 days a week
